originalEntry.title: Three.js cartoon short from an invented story
originalEntry.author: Ryzoft
originalEntry.description: An almost five-minute three.js animated short: Opus invents its own story and animates it as a 90s-style cartoon; run as a background prompt.
originalEntry.description_zh: 近 5 分钟的 Three.js 动画短片，故事由 Opus 自己编，画成 90 年代卡通风。
originalEntry.prompt: I want you to imagine a story. And then using threejs I want you to create full animation, star wars 80s-level quality 90s cartoon out of the story you imagine.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 我要你想象一个故事。然后用 threejs 把你想象的这个故事做成一部完整动画，80 年代星球大战级别的质量、90 年代卡通风格。
